svg.text: Data: CA1 local field potentials, five rats
odor-sequence task; one trial = one collection of five graphs
nodes = electrodes (vary per animal), edges = connectivity
attention ranks nodes; keep those above τ
with induced edges; no shared node identities needed
similarity links join selected nodes across animals (no correspondences)
shared transformer decodes the odor; selections are inspectable
each odor presentation is one recorded trial
five graphs with different node sets, recorded separately
interpretation: how often each electrode is selected
selection frequency rises toward distal CA1 in every animal
shared meta-graph, one prediction, inspectable structure
